params.body:
Supersedes #401.

**Current insight, same link.** A share of the same title on the same project, written through the gateway, is now a newer version of the same share: the text and the end date move, the link and the passphrase already sent stay, `version` counts up, the reading page says "Updated <date>", and the hand's read answers `version` and `updated`. An ended share stays ended and a new one is made. So the owner can keep sharing the current state of a document to the same link and word.

**A reading page that reads like a document.** The first version was a narrow column of small sans type with hairline rules, and a forty-page brief in it felt cramped. Now: a measure of about eighty characters at 19px, the running text, the title and the section headings in the house serif, a lead paragraph, tables in the sans, ruled rather than boxed and wide enough to read a comparison across a row. Tokens from base.css only. The owner's form side is unchanged.

Tests: `IngestShareTest` gains the re-share case (same id, same token, same hash, version 2; a different title or an ended share makes a new one). Pint and PHPStan clean; full suite run.
